import unittest
from shortener import URLShortener
from storage import MemoryStore
from api import ShortenerAPI
from validators import validate_url, validate_custom_code


# CHECKPOINT 1
class TestOrientation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shortener_creates_code(self):
        """Basic shortening should return a non-empty code"""
        s = URLShortener()
        code = s.shorten('https://example.com')
        self.assertTrue(len(code) > 0)

    def test_resolve_returns_original_url(self):
        """Resolve should return the original URL and track clicks"""
        s = URLShortener()
        code = s.shorten('https://example.com')
        url = s.resolve(code)
        self.assertEqual(url, 'https://example.com')
        self.assertEqual(s.stats(code)['clicks'], 1)


# CHECKPOINT 2
class TestCoreFeature(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_api_tracks_redirect_analytics(self):
        """redirect should record a timestamp in analytics history"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.create('https://example.com', custom_code='abc123')
        api.redirect('abc123')
        info = api.get_info('abc123')
        self.assertEqual(len(info['history']), 1)
        self.assertIsInstance(info['history'][0], str)

    def test_api_tracks_multiple_redirects(self):
        """Multiple redirects should append multiple timestamps"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.create('https://foo.com', custom_code='foo')
        api.redirect('foo')
        api.redirect('foo')
        info = api.get_info('foo')
        self.assertEqual(len(info['history']), 2)


# CHECKPOINT 3
class TestIntegration(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_top_links_returns_sorted(self):
        """top_links should return codes sorted by click count descending"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.create('https://a.com', custom_code='a')
        api.create('https://b.com', custom_code='b')
        api.create('https://c.com', custom_code='c')
        api.redirect('b')
        api.redirect('b')
        api.redirect('c')
        top = api.top_links(n=2)
        self.assertEqual(top[0]['short_code'], 'b')
        self.assertEqual(top[1]['short_code'], 'c')

    def test_top_links_respects_limit(self):
        """top_links(n=2) should return exactly 2 items"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.create('https://x.com', custom_code='x')
        api.create('https://y.com', custom_code='y')
        api.create('https://z.com', custom_code='z')
        top = api.top_links(n=2)
        self.assertEqual(len(top), 2)

    def test_cleanup_removes_expired(self):
        """cleanup_expired should remove codes past their TTL"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.shortener.store.save('old', 'https://old.com', ttl=-1)
        api.shortener.store.save('new', 'https://new.com', ttl=3600)
        api.cleanup_expired()
        self.assertIsNone(api.shortener.store.get('old'))
        self.assertIsNotNone(api.shortener.store.get('new'))


# CHECKPOINT 4
class TestPolish(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_export_report(self):
        """export_report should return totals and averages"""
        api = ShortenerAPI()
        api.create('https://a.com', custom_code='a')
        api.create('https://b.com', custom_code='b')
        api.redirect('a')
        api.redirect('a')
        api.redirect('b')
        report = api.export_report()
        self.assertEqual(report['total_links'], 2)
        self.assertEqual(report['total_clicks'], 3)
        self.assertEqual(report['average_clicks'], 1.5)

    def test_validate_url_rejects_invalid(self):
        """validate_url should raise on bad input"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_url('ftp://bad.com')

    def test_validate_custom_code_rejects_bad(self):
        """validate_custom_code should reject codes with special chars"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            validate_custom_code('hello world')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import datetime
import unittest
from room import Room
from scheduler import Scheduler
from conflicts import detect_conflicts, find_free_slots
from notifications import format_notification, batch_notifications, upcoming_meetings


# CHECKPOINT 1
class TestOrientation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_room_book_and_cancel(self):
        """Basic room booking and cancellation should work"""
        room = Room('R1', 'Alpha', 10)
        start = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0)
        end = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0)
        room.book('M1', start, end, 'alice')
        self.assertFalse(room.is_available(start, end))
        room.cancel('M1')
        self.assertTrue(room.is_available(start, end))

    def test_scheduler_finds_room(self):
        """Scheduler should find and book an available room"""
        s = Scheduler([Room('R1', 'Alpha', 10)])
        start = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0)
        end = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0)
        mid = s.schedule_meeting('Standup', 5, start, end, 'alice')
        self.assertEqual(mid, 'M1')


# CHECKPOINT 2
class TestCoreFeature(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_room_utilization(self):
        """Utilization should compute percentage of booked time in a day"""
        room = Room('R1', 'Alpha', 10)
        day = datetime.date(2024, 6, 1)
        start = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0)
        end = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 11, 0)
        room.book('M1', start, end, 'alice')
        util = room.utilization(day)
        self.assertEqual(util, 0.25)

    def test_find_free_slots(self):
        """find_free_slots should return available gaps"""
        blocks = [
            {'meeting_id': 'M1', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0), 'end': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0)},
            {'meeting_id': 'M2', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 11, 0), 'end': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 12, 0)},
        ]
        day_start = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 8, 0)
        day_end = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 17, 0)
        slots = find_free_slots(blocks, day_start, day_end, 60)
        self.assertEqual(len(slots), 2)
        self.assertEqual(slots[0], (datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 8, 0), datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0)))


# CHECKPOINT 3
class TestIntegration(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_suggest_alternative(self):
        """suggest_alternative should return next available slot"""
        room = Room('R1', 'Alpha', 10)
        start = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0)
        end = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0)
        room.book('M1', start, end, 'alice')
        s = Scheduler([room])
        alt = s.suggest_alternative(5, start, end, 'bob')
        self.assertIsNotNone(alt)
        self.assertTrue(alt['start'] >= end)

    def test_daily_overview(self):
        """daily_overview should group meetings by room"""
        r1 = Room('R1', 'Alpha', 10)
        r2 = Room('R2', 'Beta', 5)
        s = Scheduler([r1, r2])
        day = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1)
        s.schedule_meeting('A', 5, datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0), datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0), 'alice')
        s.schedule_meeting('B', 3, datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0), datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0), 'bob')
        overview = s.daily_overview(day.date())
        self.assertEqual(len(overview), 2)


# CHECKPOINT 4
class TestPolish(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_batch_notifications(self):
        """batch_notifications should return a list of notification dicts"""
        meetings = [
            {'title': 'A', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0), 'organizer': 'alice'},
        ]
        notes = batch_notifications(meetings)
        self.assertEqual(len(notes), 1)
        self.assertEqual(notes[0]['recipient'], 'alice')

    def test_upcoming_meetings(self):
        """upcoming_meetings should filter by window"""
        now = datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 8, 0)
        meetings = [
            {'title': 'A', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 8, 30), 'organizer': 'alice'},
            {'title': 'B', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0), 'organizer': 'bob'},
        ]
        upcoming = upcoming_meetings(meetings, now, 60)
        self.assertEqual(len(upcoming), 1)
        self.assertEqual(upcoming[0]['title'], 'A')

    def test_detect_conflicts(self):
        """detect_conflicts should find overlapping meetings"""
        blocks = [
            {'meeting_id': 'M1', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 9, 0), 'end': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 11, 0)},
            {'meeting_id': 'M2', 'start': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 10, 0), 'end': datetime.datetime(2024, 6, 1, 12, 0)},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(detect_conflicts(blocks)), 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
